title: 第3章 哪吒下界第4章 选猴王
content_zh:
灵山。
如来佛祖眉头微皱，闭目推演。
周围一众菩萨罗汉，静静等候。
过了片刻。
如来佛祖缓缓睁开双眼。
一众菩萨罗汉，纷纷看向佛祖。
如来摇头：
“怪哉！”
“吾推演整个三界，也没能算出这孩童来历。”
听到如来的话。
在场一众菩萨罗汉，眉头纷纷皱起。
如来佛祖是谁？
是灵山众佛之首！
是万佛之祖！
这样的存在，竟无法推演出那孩童的来历？
一众罗汉中。
为首的降龙罗汉，率先站出来：
“佛祖，弟子愿前往花果山！”
“收这孩童为弟子！”
降龙罗汉的话音刚一落下。

伏虎罗汉紧随其后：
“佛祖，弟子也愿前往！”
所有人都不是傻子。
大家都清楚。
那石猴可是西游量劫的关键人物。
眼下。
这随石猴一同出世的孩童，必也不简单！
一众罗汉也知道。
石猴以后肯定是由佛祖亲自培养。
但这与石猴一同出世的孩童，却还没有师承。
众所周知。
那块天地奇石，乃上古圣人“女娲”
补天所留。
这等奇石中孕育的生命，又岂会寻常？
其余罗汉、护法，甚至连菩萨也纷纷开口。
“佛祖，我等也愿下界。”
“收这孩童为弟子！”
见到这一幕。
观音菩萨却是摇了摇头。
一众菩萨罗汉见观音摇头，有些不解。
content_en:
Lingshan.
Tathagata Buddha frowned slightly and closed his eyes to deduce.
A group of Bodhisattvas and Arhats were waiting quietly around.
After a while.
Tathagata Buddha slowly opened his eyes.
All the Bodhisattvas and Arhats looked at the Buddha one after another.
Tathagata shook his head:
"Weird!"
"I deduced the entire Three Realms, but I couldn't figure out the origin of this child."
Hear the words of the Tathagata.
All the Bodhisattvas and Arhats present frowned.
Who is Tathagata Buddha?
It is the first of all the Buddhas in Lingshan!
He is the ancestor of ten thousand Buddhas!
Such an existence cannot deduce the origin of the child?
Among all the Arhats.
The leader, Subduing the Dragon Arhat, was the first to stand up:
"Buddha, my disciples are willing to go to Huaguo Mountain!"
"Accept this child as a disciple!"
The voice of Subduing the Dragon Arhat had just finished.
Crouching Tiger Arhat followed closely:
"Buddha, my disciples are also willing to go!"
Everyone is not a fool.
Everyone knows it.
The stone monkey is a key figure in the journey to the west.
at the moment.
This child who was born with Stone Monkey must not be simple!
All the Arhats also knew it.
The stone monkey will definitely be cultivated by Buddha himself in the future.
But the child born together with Stone Monkey has not yet learned from his master.
As everyone knows.
That strange stone from heaven and earth is the ancient saint "Nuwa"
Make up for what's left in the sky.
How could the life bred in such strange rocks be ordinary?
The other Arhats, Dharma Protectors, and even Bodhisattvas also spoke.
"Buddha, we also wish to go down to the next world."
"Accept this child as a disciple!"
Saw this scene.
Guanyin Bodhisattva shook his head.
The group of Bodhisattvas and Arhats were a little puzzled when they saw Guanyin shaking her head.
